findings.highlight: I don't think she'd go out of her way to verify them
findings.evidenceJa: 疑問があっても、無理やり抑え込んでしまうだろう
findings.explanation: Haruki predicts that even if Setsuna has doubts, she will forcibly suppress them. The translation merely says she will not take the trouble to verify them, losing the active self-suppression central to his exploitation of her trust.
findings.japanese:
このメールを見て、
きっと雪菜は納得してしまうだろう。
疑問があっても、無理やり抑え込んでしまうだろう。
findings.todokanai: I'm sure Setsuna will be convinced with this text. Even if she had doubts, I don't think she'd go out of her way to verify them.

findings.highlight: There's been no new text from Setsuna since the day before yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 受信簿に、一昨日の雪菜からのメールはない
findings.explanation: Haruki observes that Setsuna's specific message from the day before yesterday is absent from his inbox. The translation instead says she has sent nothing since that day, changing the clue he is checking.
findings.japanese: やっぱり受信簿に、一昨日の雪菜からのメールはない。
findings.todokanai: There's been no new text from Setsuna since the day before yesterday, as I thought.
